[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}
is_a: MONDO:0005047 {source="https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/", source="OMIM:616947", source="OMIM:616950"} ! infertility disorder

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]
synonym: "SYCE1-related gametogenic failure" EXACT [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/] {OMO:0002001="https://w3id.org/information-resource-registry/clingen"}

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012

id: MONDO:7770012

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012

id: MONDO:7770012

name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

id: MONDO:7770012

name: odk
description: Use when running any ODK-backed command in this repo — owltools, robot, make NORM,
  robot verify, or any other tool that lives inside the ODK docker image
---

# Running ODK commands in this repo

## TL;DR

`src/ontology/run.sh` is the official wrapper, but it ends in `docker run -ti` so it **fails silently in any non-TTY context** (Claude Code, CI, non-interactive shells) with `the input device is not a TTY` and exits without running the command.

If you have a TTY, prefer `run.sh`. If you don't, call docker directly with `-i` only.

## When you have a TTY (interactive terminal)

```bash
cd src/ontology && sh run.sh <command> <args...>
```

Examples:
```bash
sh run.sh make NORM
sh run.sh owltools --use-catalog mondo-edit.obo --obsolete-replace MONDO:A MONDO:B -o -f obo mondo-edit.obo
sh run.sh robot verify --catalog catalog-v001.xml -i mondo-edit.obo --queries ../sparql/qc/general/qc-foo.sparql -O reports/
```

## When you don't have a TTY (Claude Code, CI, scripts)

Symptom: `sh run.sh <anything>` prints `the input device is not a TTY` and exits with no further output, no file changes.

Workaround — invoke docker directly using the same image and mounts as `run.sh`, but with `-i` only:

```bash
docker run --memory=8g \
  -v /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/REPO:/work \
  -w /work/src/ontology \
  -e ROBOT_JAVA_ARGS=-Xmx8G -e JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx8G \
  --rm -i obolibrary/odkfull:<TAG-FROM-RUN.SH> \
  <command> <args...>
```

Where:
- `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/REPO` = the repo root (the parent of `src/`).
- `<TAG-FROM-RUN.SH>` = whatever tag is set in `IMAGE=` in `src/ontology/run.sh`. **Always read `run.sh` first to look up the current tag** — do not hardcode `v1.6` or any other version.

## Reading the right image tag

Don't memorize the version. The line in `run.sh` is the source of truth:

```bash
grep '^IMAGE=' src/ontology/run.sh
# IMAGE=${IMAGE:-odkfull:v1.6}
```

## Common ODK commands you'll need

| What | Command body (after `run.sh` or after the `docker run ... -i obolibrary/odkfull:<TAG>` prefix) |
|---|---|
| Normalize edit file | `make NORM` then `mv NORM mondo-edit.obo` (run from `src/ontology`) |
| Convert / syntax check | `robot convert --catalog catalog-v001.xml -i mondo-edit.obo -f obo -o mondo-edit.TMP.obo` |
| Run a QC query | `robot verify --catalog catalog-v001.xml -i mondo-edit.obo --queries ../sparql/qc/general/qc-X.sparql -O reports/` |
| Merge / obsolete with replacement | `owltools --use-catalog mondo-edit.obo --obsolete-replace MONDO:A MONDO:B -o -f obo mondo-edit.obo` |

## Notes

- All ODK commands assume CWD is `src/ontology/`.
- `make NORM` writes to a file called `NORM` in `src/ontology/`. You must `mv NORM mondo-edit.obo` afterward.
- `robot verify` exits non-zero on QC failures and writes one TSV per failing query under `-O reports/`. Empty exit + `PASS Rule ... 0 violation(s)` = clean.
- If `run.sh` reports `the input device is not a TTY`, do **not** retry the same command — it will keep failing. Switch to the docker-direct invocation.

[Term]
id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

id: MONDO:7770012
name: SYCE1-related gametogenic failure
def: "Any infertility disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the SYCE1 gene. In 46,XY individuals, this condition can present as non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest or meiotic failure; in 46,XX individuals, it can present as primary ovarian insufficiency." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, OMIM:616947, OMIM:616950]

This PR addresses #9864 by adding a new MONDO term for ClinGen Male Infertility GCEP's requested label:

- Added `MONDO:7770012` **SYCE1-related gametogenic failure**
- Defined it as an infertility disorder caused by variation in `SYCE1`, with the 46,XY and 46,XX presentations described in the issue
- Added a ClinGen preferred-label synonym annotation using the Male Infertility GCEP URL

This PR addresses #9864 by adding a new MONDO term for ClinGen Male Infertility GCEP's requested label:

- Added `MONDO:7770012` **SYCE1-related gametogenic failure**
- Defined it as an infertility disorder caused by variation in `SYCE1`, with the 46,XY and 46,XX presentations described in the issue
- Added a ClinGen preferred-label synonym annotation using the Male Infertility GCEP URL
- Added a logical definition and asserted `has_material_basis_in_germline_mutation_in` relationship to `SYCE1` (`http://identifiers.org/hgnc/28852`)
- Linked the existing SYCE1-specific terms as children:

Individuals with variants in SYCE1 may present with varying phenotypes. 46XY individuals can present with non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest/meiotic failure. 46XX individuals can present with primary ovarian insufficiency (POI).

name: NR5A1-related sex development disorder
def: "A reproductive system disorder caused by a variation in the NR5A1 gene, and characterized by varying phenotypes, including partial or complete gonadal dysgenesis, ambiguous genitalia, and spermatogenic failure in the male, and premature ovarian failure and ovarian dysgenesis in the female." [https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/, PMID:28033660, PMID:31513305]
comment: 46XY individuals can present with azoospermia, hypospadias, micropenis, cryptorchidism, ambiguous or female-appearing genitalia, partial or complete gonadal dysgenesis, Sertoli dysfunction, and progressive testicular failure. Leydig function is often partially preserved, and infertility is common. 46XX individuals can present with primary ovarian insufficiency/ premature ovarian failure, ovarian dysgenesis, and subfertility. Rarely, testicular or ovotesticular disorder of sex development may occur. Individuals typically have normal adrenal function but in rare cases, adrenal insufficiency may be observed in the context of severe-early onset variants.

---
name: odk
description: Use when running any ODK-backed command in this repo — owltools, robot, make NORM,
  robot verify, or any other tool that lives inside the ODK docker image
---

# Running ODK commands in this repo

## TL;DR

`src/ontology/run.sh` is the official wrapper, but it ends in `docker run -ti` so it **fails silently in any non-TTY context** (Claude Code, CI, non-interactive shells) with `the input device is not a TTY` and exits without running the command.

If you have a TTY, prefer `run.sh`. If you don't, call docker directly with `-i` only.

## When you have a TTY (interactive terminal)

```bash
cd src/ontology && sh run.sh <command> <args...>
```

Examples:
```bash
sh run.sh make NORM
sh run.sh owltools --use-catalog mondo-edit.obo --obsolete-replace MONDO:A MONDO:B -o -f obo mondo-edit.obo
sh run.sh robot verify --catalog catalog-v001.xml -i mondo-edit.obo --queries ../sparql/qc/general/qc-foo.sparql -O reports/
```

## When you don't have a TTY (Claude Code, CI, scripts)

Symptom: `sh run.sh <anything>` prints `the input device is not a TTY` and exits with no further output, no file changes.

Workaround — invoke docker directly using the same image and mounts as `run.sh`, but with `-i` only:

```bash
docker run --memory=8g \
  -v /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/REPO:/work \
  -w /work/src/ontology \
  -e ROBOT_JAVA_ARGS=-Xmx8G -e JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx8G \
  --rm -i obolibrary/odkfull:<TAG-FROM-RUN.SH> \
  <command> <args...>
```

Where:
- `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/REPO` = the repo root (the parent of `src/`).
- `<TAG-FROM-RUN.SH>` = whatever tag is set in `IMAGE=` in `src/ontology/run.sh`. **Always read `run.sh` first to look up the current tag** — do not hardcode `v1.6` or any other version.

## Reading the right image tag

Don't memorize the version. The line in `run.sh` is the source of truth:

```bash
grep '^IMAGE=' src/ontology/run.sh
# IMAGE=${IMAGE:-odkfull:v1.6}
```

## Common ODK commands you'll need

| What | Command body (after `run.sh` or after the `docker run ... -i obolibrary/odkfull:<TAG>` prefix) |
|---|---|
| Normalize edit file | `make NORM` then `mv NORM mondo-edit.obo` (run from `src/ontology`) |
| Convert / syntax check | `robot convert --catalog catalog-v001.xml -i mondo-edit.obo -f obo -o mondo-edit.TMP.obo` |
| Run a QC query | `robot verify --catalog catalog-v001.xml -i mondo-edit.obo --queries ../sparql/qc/general/qc-X.sparql -O reports/` |
| Merge / obsolete with replacement | `owltools --use-catalog mondo-edit.obo --obsolete-replace MONDO:A MONDO:B -o -f obo mondo-edit.obo` |

## Notes

- All ODK commands assume CWD is `src/ontology/`.
- `make NORM` writes to a file called `NORM` in `src/ontology/`. You must `mv NORM mondo-edit.obo` afterward.
- `robot verify` exits non-zero on QC failures and writes one TSV per failing query under `-O reports/`. Empty exit + `PASS Rule ... 0 violation(s)` = clean.
- If `run.sh` reports `the input device is not a TTY`, do **not** retry the same command — it will keep failing. Switch to the docker-direct invocation.

arguments.content:
## Summary

This PR addresses #9864 by adding a new MONDO term for ClinGen Male Infertility GCEP's requested label:

- Added `MONDO:7770012` **SYCE1-related gametogenic failure**
- Defined it as an infertility disorder caused by variation in `SYCE1`, with the 46,XY and 46,XX presentations described in the issue
- Added a ClinGen preferred-label synonym annotation using the Male Infertility GCEP URL
- Added a logical definition and asserted `has_material_basis_in_germline_mutation_in` relationship to `SYCE1` (`http://identifiers.org/hgnc/28852`)
- Linked the existing SYCE1-specific terms as children:
  - `MONDO:0014844` premature ovarian failure 12
  - `MONDO:0014847` spermatogenic failure 15

## Rationale and checks

Checklist completed:

- Reviewed issue #9864 context and the ClinGen Male Infertility GCEP URL supplied in the comments.
- Checked existing SYCE1-related MONDO terms (`MONDO:0014844`, `MONDO:0014847`) for parentage, sources, and the verified HGNC identifier for `SYCE1`.
- Checked the applicable gene-related disease pattern guidance (`disease_series_by_gene.yaml`).
- Used the next available temporary new-term identifier in the `MONDO:777xxxx` range (`MONDO:7770012`).
- Preserved existing parents on the existing terms and only added the more specific new parent.
- Normalized `src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo` with `make NORM` followed by replacing `mondo-edit.obo`.
- Validated OBO syntax with:
  - `robot convert --catalog src/ontology/catalog-v001.xml -i src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo -f obo -o mondo-edit.TMP.obo`
- Ran `git diff --check` for whitespace issues.
